meaning: Executable references bind the 100 normative scenarios to implementation evidence. Binding validation is structural; passing tests alone is not packet or native certification.

module_map_divergences.reason: Shared start-command scope/proof/coalescing authority; three registered worker kinds reuse one bounded batch engine.
Both reuse the existing LLD-02 SettingService participant and audit authority.
Owned SQLite FTS triggers atomically maintain the retained-content projection, including reconstruction and purge; no empty wrapper.

proposal_boundary: Only complete registered typed facts may enter repositories/proposals.py in the caller receipt/UoW. Accepted owner clarification does not authorize a natural-language lifecycle extractor. RT context and missing-reference warning are advisory process-local typed values; CLOSED never supplies a final decision. LLD-10 owns workbench presentation.

cases.scenario: Source Scope creation assigns immutable local identity independent of filesystem path.
Moving or renaming the same accepted PST/OST location preserves Source Scope identity after reviewed relocation.
A genuinely different mailbox/account requires a distinct Source Scope even when filenames match.
Automatic processing is blocked when no governed trackable operational identity exists.
Creating descriptive/master data alone does not satisfy the processing eligibility gate.
Accepted SR/RFC/WFM/Objective/Spare Request/RMA/Fault Tag identities enter the versioned trackable registry according to owner rules.
Local Task without an accepted external communication identifier remains non-trackable automatically.
Initial processing chooses the earliest independently supported relevant target chronology.
Unknown earliest relevant chronology remains unknown and requires operator lower bound or Deep Scan.
Import/discovery/index/current time never substitutes for missing business chronology.
Ordinary processing opens PST/OST read-only and never mutates external stores.
High-water advances only through the last durably committed provider checkpoint.
Bounded overlap replay is idempotent and does not duplicate retained communications or links.
Targeted backfill affects only selected Source Scope/folders/identities/range and leaves unrelated high-water unchanged.
Deep Scan always presents explicit scope/range/impact/coverage preview before start.
Deep Scan requires valid deliberate-action proof and cannot be started by timer/startup/failure fallback.
Provider-stable origin identity yields one canonical Communication within one accepted Source Scope.
Equal provider identities in different unconfirmed Source Scopes do not silently merge.
Fallback identity canonicalization is versioned, deterministic, path-independent and scope-bound.
Fallback collisions preserve separate immutable Communication candidates pending review.
A later stronger provider identity attaches as alias/reconciliation evidence without replacing internal communication_id.
Folder movement/duplication within one Source Scope does not create another canonical Communication.
Participants persist as ordered typed role-bearing values with unknown/malformed evidence preserved explicitly.
Participant names/addresses do not automatically create or prove Contact identity.
Direction is derived from source scope/folder role/participants and remains UNKNOWN when conflicting or unsupported.
Unmatched inspected messages leave no persisted subject/body/participants/attachments/searchable or opaque reconstructable equivalent.
Only bounded scan/job progress, counts, coverage and redacted diagnostics survive unmatched inspection.
An accepted or approved-safe governed entity link makes matched content eligible for retention.
One canonical Communication may hold independent accepted links to multiple governed entities.
Correcting/removing one link leaves the canonical message and other links unchanged.
Rejected or corrected-away final links start orphan-grace evaluation rather than immediate content deletion.
Communication-derived lifecycle facts are persisted only as proposals and do not mutate owner domains.
Accepted proposal evidence is consumed by the owning domain with fresh validation; LLD-09 records disposition only.
Rejected/deferred proposal produces no owner-domain mutation.
RFC provider terminal evidence/pending cascade alone does not unlink direct RFC Communication links.

Confirmed local RFC terminal cascade first revalidates inside the caller LLD-03 writer UnitOfWork that the complete current Communications impact exact_count/provider_fingerprint exactly equals the reviewed READY preview authority; a determinate mismatch is STALE and INDETERMINATE fails closed before deliberate proof consumption/apply. Only after READY revalidation may apply freeze the RFC terminal summary, remove only RFC direct links and evaluate orphan grace in that same caller UoW without a nested receipt/commit.
Accepted SR terminal transition freezes SR terminal summary and removes only SR direct links.
Terminal summary preserves counts/direction/chronology/coverage/unlink time without reconstructable content or body navigation.
Final protected dependency removal enters ORPHAN_PENDING_PURGE with exact grace due time.
Default orphan grace is seven exact elapsed days from accepted last-dependency removal.
Restored protected dependency during grace cancels pending purge and preserves cancellation audit history.
Due purge transaction revalidates every protected link/proposal/correction/collision/export hold before content deletion.
Due purge with a restored dependency cancels purge and preserves retained content.
Eligible purge removes body/subject/participants/attachments/content-derived search material but preserves minimized non-reconstructable identity/history evidence.
Purge never modifies PST/OST, existing MSG exports, portable exports, protected backups or operational domain history.
Terminal reversal during grace restores governed relationship and cancels purge.
Terminal reversal after purge queues bounded targeted source backfill when source is available.
Post-purge reversal with unavailable/incomplete source keeps frozen summary and explicit coverage warning without fabricated body.
Processing schedule defaults to 60 whole minutes and may be changed to another allowed positive whole-minute interval or disabled.
Disabling scheduled processing preserves source configuration, coverage, high-water, retained communications and housekeeping.
Check now coalesces with an already active per-scope ordinary processing job rather than creating overlap.
At most one startup catch-up remains pending per Source Scope.
Orphan housekeeping runs independently from Communication Processing schedule.
Long ordinary/backfill/Deep Scan/reconciliation/housekeeping work exposes durable job identity/state/phase/times/counts/checkpoint.
Unknown job totals never yield fabricated progress percentage.
Cooperative cancellation preserves completed commits and never advances coverage past durable work.
Restart recovery resumes from safe checkpoint or records explicit partial/failure state; it never marks success by crash.
Retry is transient-only, bounded, backed off and idempotent.
Diagnostics expose stable codes/safe counts/redacted scope/remediation without reconstructable mail or secrets.
MSG draft generation creates immutable draft identity distinct from canonical Communication identity.
MSG draft generation builds/verifies/publishes artifact before one short DB UoW records/reuses draft/export evidence.
Successful MSG export does not mark sent, change communication counts, or advance source coverage/high-water.
DB failure after matching artifact publication is safely reconciled by idempotent retry using semantic key and artifact hash.
Later PST/OST discovery of a sent item creates normal canonical Communication and may link draft provenance without identity merge.
Entity communication summary counts one canonical message once per entity despite multiple aliases/links to the same entity.
Current summaries exclude rejected/corrected links and MSG drafts, show last independently known interaction time/age, proposals and coverage warnings.
LLD-10/11 read summaries through CommunicationSummaryProvider and never store a competing body/count authority.
Crash before retained-message/link batch commit rolls back content/link/proposal writes and leaves high-water unchanged.
Crash after committed batch but before job heartbeat recovers from durable checkpoint without duplicate messages or links.
Source becomes missing/locked/corrupt mid-run: committed prior work remains, coverage becomes partial/warned, no external mutation occurs.
Concurrent source-scope reconfiguration makes an in-flight start/checkpoint stale and prevents checkpoint advancement under old scope revision.
Concurrent target terminal/correction change invalidates a proposed link before commit and fails closed without retention by that stale target.
Failure in owning-domain proposal command rolls back LLD-09 disposition participant changes in the shared UoW.
Failure in RfcTerminalCommunicationParticipant aborts the caller RFC cascade transaction rather than partially unlinking Communications.
Failure after terminal summary creation but before direct-link closure rolls back both summary and link changes.
Failure during due purge after dependency revalidation rolls back content/search deletion and keeps communication retained/pending for retry.
MSG artifact publication failure creates no authoritative draft/export DB mutation and no sent evidence.
DB failure after MSG artifact publication leaves operator artifact non-authoritative; retry reconciles identical artifact hash without duplicate draft identity.
Cancellation during large scan occurs only at safe checkpoint and cannot split one atomic persistence batch.
Transient retry exhaustion records failed/partial job with last durable coverage; no tight retry loop or fabricated success.
Unmatched message subject/body/participants/attachments are absent from all persistent tables, FTS, audit, diagnostics and job checkpoint payloads.
Audit payloads never contain message body, attachment bytes, participant email addresses, raw PST/OST path, source credentials or MSG body.
Diagnostics and support surfaces use stable codes/safe counts/redacted scope and never reconstruct a retained or unmatched message.
Search indexes contain retained content only and are deleted transactionally with eligible content purge.
Purge evidence and frozen terminal summaries cannot reconstruct subject/body/participants/attachments.
HTTP URLs/query strings never carry PST/OST path, message body, recipient lists, attachment bytes or MSG destination path.
Source adapter opens external stores read-only; no command exposes delete/move/mark/read-state mutation capability.
Deep Scan requires authenticated mutation + CSRF + valid single-use LLD-12 deliberate-action proof bound to exact preview/target revision.
cases.host_dependency: LLD-12 authentication/CSRF and real session/run-bound deliberate proof; LLD-09 consumer verified with injected proof provider

cases.scenario: Golden PST fixture on supported Windows/Python exposes the same provider-stable identity, chronology, folder role and participants through the pinned libpff adapter.
Golden OST fixture on supported Windows/Python is opened read-only and yields bounded deterministic TransientMessageV1 values.
Provider RecordKey/stable-origin binary evidence is preserved byte-exact before versioned encoding and scoped to the accepted Source Scope.
Messages lacking stable origin identity produce identical fallback canonical bytes/digest across restart on the same adapter/canonicalization version.
Fallback canonicalization changes require an explicit version change and preserve existing aliases/reconciliation history.
Malformed/corrupt messages produce stable adapter warnings/errors without leaking raw content or crashing the whole source run.
Unsupported or partially parseable stores return bounded source-health/capability states and do not advance unreadable coverage.
Folder movement within the same store does not change canonical identity when provider-stable identity remains available.
Duplicate copies with same provider identity within one accepted Source Scope reconcile idempotently rather than creating duplicate canonical messages.
Generated MSG fixture passes independent Compound File/OXMSG verification and reopens with exact normalized subject/body/recipient snapshot.
Generated MSG fixture opens in supported Outlook/Windows compatibility fixture while remaining unsent and without delivery/read-receipt proof.
Parser/writer dependency upgrade is blocked unless the full LLD-09 golden corpus, privacy canaries and identity/MSG compatibility fixtures pass.
